title: Non-Compartmental PK Analysis (PKNCA)
description: Non-compartmental pharmacokinetic analysis of concentration-time data using PKNCA. Computes AUC, Cmax, t½, CL, Vd.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input_csv.description: CSV with columns: subject_id, time, concentration. Must match time_unit and conc_unit.

dose.description: Administered dose amount in the same unit system as CL/F denominator.

route.description: Route of administration. iv = intravenous bolus; oral = extravascular. Affects AUC integration and F calculation.

time_unit.description: Time axis unit label (e.g. h, min, d). Used for axis labels and t½ units.

conc_unit.description: Concentration unit label (e.g. ng/mL, μM, nM). Used for axis labels and CL units.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
